items.title: Flat pullback commutes with capping with a first Chern class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projection formula for a first Chern class against flat pullback: f^*(c_1(L) cap alpha) = c_1(f^*L) cap f^*alpha for a flat morphism of relative dimension r (statement lines 4532-4544, tag 02SS). The proof reduces to a single integral class through the infinite sums remark, base changes to the preimage of that class, decomposes the preimage cycle into its components with multiplicities, and then invokes the divisor pullback lemma to obtain the comparison of cycles whose two sides push down to the two sides of the identity. The reduction to the preimage and the pushforward comparison are the substance, so the claim is H2.
